# Yora Health

> Yora Health builds Yora Intelligence — supplement product intelligence that resolves products, normalizes ingredients and dosages, assesses formulation quality and verification evidence, and explains results for enterprise platforms and consumers.

## About

Yora helps healthcare, practitioner, retail, brand and AI platforms evaluate supplement products with clarity. At the centre is a two-score architecture: Product Score (formulation quality) and Verification Score (supporting evidence). These are proprietary analytical outputs — not Health Canada ratings, approvals or certifications.

Pipeline: Resolve → Normalize → Assess → Explain.

Geography / language: Canada-focused brand presence; site language English (en-CA).

## Key facts for citation

- Organization: Yora Health
- Product: Yora Intelligence (enterprise APIs / workflows) and Yora Health App (consumer, coming soon)
- Scores: Product Score and Verification Score are independent dimensions
- Evidence sources referenced: Health Canada NHP monographs, LNHPD/NPN, NIH ODS, NIH/IOM Dietary Reference Intakes, NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database
- Validation focus: product resolution, ingredient extraction, dosage extraction, confidence, explainability
- Contact: hello@yora.health
- Positioning: decision-support intelligence, not medical advice or a replacement for professional judgement
- Important: Product Score and Verification Score are not Health Canada ratings, approvals or certifications
